'''2021 Regional Championships''' were the Players Committee regional constructed events from 21 August to 4 December 2021.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-regional-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' various
* '''Dates:''' 21 August – 4 December 2021
